verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents an official `humanlayer` CLI: `humanlayer automation run` launches Cloud-visible coding sessions from CI, cron or scripts, and the remote-daemon guide covers installing, authenticating and launching daemons, including non-interactive launch-token use. A probe confirms the CLI is documented on the remote-daemons guide. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference beyond automation and daemon commands, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
